brief:
A year after Gaza's ceasefire, Palestinians continue dying from preventable illnesses as Israel maintains restrictions on medical supplies and humanitarian access, Middle East Eye reported. The blockade has left the territory without adequate healthcare infrastructure, forcing residents to forgo treatment for treatable conditions.

The crisis extends beyond medical shortages to encompass broader humanitarian collapse. Palestinians lack safe shelter and basic services needed to sustain life, compounding the toll of restricted aid flows into the enclave.

title: Israel's blockade kills Palestinians denied medical care in Gaza
